verdict.rationale: Agora is a real-time media platform, so documentation on how its media layer scales across nodes or regions is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence describes managed autoscaling, multi-region distribution, or self-hosted clustering of the media layer. Cloud proxy firewall whitelisting, self-hosted recording and CDN delivery are adjacent features, not scaling documentation.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the vendor documents how the media layer scales across nodes or regions, whether managed autoscaling or self-hosted clustering
